meta.title: IPv6 Capability
meta.valueLabel: Share of measured users whose connection can use IPv6
meta.summary: Share of internet users whose connection and device can reach a site over IPv6, the successor to the exhausted IPv4 address space. APNIC Labs measures it with small test scripts served in online ads (millions of tests a day worldwide): a test counts as IPv6-capable when the browser fetches an IPv6-only object. Calendar-year share of all tests in the country; a year needs at least 300 days of data and 20,000 tests. Users reached through ads are not a random sample, and a mobile operator switching IPv6 on can move a country by tens of points in a year. APNIC's own country page weights each network by its estimated users; this pooled share does not, which for most large countries differs by under two points but by more where few ads are served (Russia since 2022, small islands).
meta.method: Yearly value = IPv6-capable tests / all tests seen, pooled over the calendar year from APNIC's daily per-economy series (unweighted within the country). Complete years only; country-years with under 300 days or 20,000 tests are left out.
